capabilities: Push a note to HackMD, creating it if needed
Pull remote changes into the local note
Force-overwrite the remote or local copy
extras: The README documents commands and conflict behavior but no setup or settings details, and part of it describes the maintainer release process rather than user usage.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to HackMD or keep a local note and its remote HackMD copy in sync safely.

relations.evidence: A plugin for pushing and fetching note contents between Obsidian and HackMD.

summary: Two-way sync plugin that pushes and pulls note content between Obsidian and HackMD, with conflict detection and force overrides.
